constraints.description: The portal uses canonical UAR marks and the exact light/dark surface ladders without stock Docusaurus identity.

validation.validation_method: Byte-parity checks, required-token checks, and stock-identity negative controls

constraints.description: Search and fonts are exact site-local dependencies with no hosted search, analytics, remote fonts, or Ask AI service.

validation.validation_method: Exact npm dependency resolution and hosted-service negative controls

constraints.description: The homepage is static, semantically ordered, dimensioned, and links only to existing pre-content routes.

validation.validation_method: Source structure and missing-route controls plus TypeScript checking

constraints.description: Source rejects gradients, decorative shadows and borders, invisible focus, and missing reduced-motion handling.

validation.validation_method: Isolated CSS negative controls and current Web Interface Guidelines source audit

constraints.description: Strict OpenSpec passes; only the website npm lockfile changes; runtime, React application, provider, realtime, vendored, SDK, and raw history sources remain untouched.

validation.validation_method: Strict OpenSpec and scoped git diff

global_rules: Treat the OpenSpec change and KBD phase plan as acceptance authority.
Keep GitHub Actions deployment-only and run routine verification locally.
Do not run the full site build, screenshots, or browser accessibility gate before documentation content is complete.
Do not claim rendered or deployed quality from source-level evidence.
termination_conditions: All five blocking source constraints have observed evidence.
Strict OpenSpec and both refiner schemas pass.
The review states the deferred visual evidence and dependency-advisory limits explicitly.
